statement: In the exact frozen E. coli assembly used by the pilot, the five LC-PRIM-0006 occurrences paired 119 bp downstream of LC-PRIM-0003 will annotate within the same 23S/large-subunit-rRNA elements or directly corresponding rrn-operon regions as the already validated LC-PRIM-0002/0003 occurrences.
test: Use assembly-matched U00096.3 feature annotation for the exact frozen 0-based coordinates. Do not remap to a different assembly without recording the mapping.
support_condition: All or nearly all five E. coli LC-PRIM-0006 occurrences fall inside the same 23S rRNA features / homologous rrn-operon regions as their paired LC-PRIM-0003 occurrences.
weakening_condition: They lie in the same rrn operons but outside annotated 23S features.
falsification_condition: Multiple paired LC-PRIM-0006 occurrences map outside the corresponding rrn-operon/large-subunit-rRNA contexts.
contamination_boundary: Frozen before assembly-matched E. coli annotation lookup. Existing Proof Case annotation validated LC-PRIM-0003/parent context but did not annotate LC-PRIM-0006.
